channel.title: Sound baths in Boulder · Sound Bath Calendar
channel.description: A weekly-updated calendar of sound baths in Boulder, Colorado: dates, times, venues, prices, and ticket links for every listed session. Part of the Front Range sound bath calendar.

item.title: Gong Bath with Beth
item.description: A recurring Monday-evening gong bath led by Beth at Una Vida Meditation & Movement in Longmont, Monday August 10 at 7:15 PM. Where: Una Vida Meditation & Movement, Boulder. Details: https://soundbathcalendar.com/event/gong-bath-with-beth-2026-08-10-una-vida-meditation-movement/

item.title: Eclipse Sound Journey
item.description: A two-hour eclipse gathering in Lafayette combining an astrology reading, guided meditation, vocal energy healing and chanting, with Matt, Krystal and Rebecca Abraxas, Tuesday evening. Where: 9760 Isabelle Rd, Boulder. Price: See link. Details: https://soundbathcalendar.com/event/eclipse-sound-journey-2026-08-11-9760-isabelle-rd/

item.title: Solar Eclipse Sunset Gong Bath
item.description: An outdoor sunset gong bath led by Pavanjeet at North Boulder Park in Boulder, Tuesday evening. Where: North Boulder Park, Boulder. Details: https://soundbathcalendar.com/event/solar-eclipse-sunset-gong-bath-2026-08-11-north-boulder-park/

item.title: Thompson Park Sound Bath
item.description: A free outdoor sound bath at Thompson Park in Longmont (Boulder area), Wednesday evening. Where: Thompson Park, Boulder. Price: Free. Details: https://soundbathcalendar.com/event/thompson-park-sound-bath-2026-08-12-thompson-park/

item.title: BLISS, Sacred Sound Fest
item.description: A three-day (Aug 14-16) sound-focused gathering at Wild Cider Garden in Longmont featuring sessions of sacred sound, chant, and healing sound journeys from multiple presenters. Where: Wild Cider, Boulder. Price: $22–$200. Details: https://soundbathcalendar.com/event/bliss-sacred-sound-fest-2026-08-14-wild-cider/

item.title: Friday Night Frequencies - A Soundbath to Release the Week
item.description: A Friday-evening gong bath and sound journey at Una Vida Meditation & Movement in Longmont, led by Betsy Workman. Where: Una Vida Meditation & Movement, Boulder. Price: Free. Details: https://soundbathcalendar.com/event/friday-night-frequencies-a-soundbath-to-release-the-week-2026-08-14-una-vida-meditation-movement/

item.title: Friday Night Frequencies
item.description: A Friday evening sound bath using gong and alchemy crystal bowls, led by Betsy Workman at Una Vida Meditation and Movement in Niwot on August 14, 2026. Where: Una Vida Meditation and Movement, Boulder. Price: Not listed. Details: https://soundbathcalendar.com/event/friday-night-frequencies-2026-08-14-una-vida-meditation-and-movement/

item.title: Year of the Horse: Reignite Your Flame
item.description: A full-day retreat on a Boulder-area horse ranch combining yoga, sound bath, equine therapy and art, led by Jenny McCarty and Jessica Mahan. Where: 13609 Gold Hill Rd, Boulder. Price: $297. Details: https://soundbathcalendar.com/event/year-of-the-horse-reignite-your-flame-2026-08-15-13609-gold-hill-rd/

item.title: Sound Bath Journey in the Salt Cave
item.description: A sound journey inside a Himalayan salt cave using singing bowls, Koshi chimes, harmonium, acoustic guitar, and mantras, led by kirtan artist Mira Devi at Diamond Vitality Center in Louisville. Where: 333 West South Boulder Road, Louisville, CO, Boulder. Price: $55. Details: https://soundbathcalendar.com/event/sound-bath-journey-in-the-salt-cave-2026-08-15-333-west-south-boulder-road-louisville-co/

item.title: Sound Circle & Energy Healing Sound Bath with Bruce White
item.description: A sliding-scale ($15-$25) sound circle and crystal-bowl session led by Bruce White at Unity of Boulder's Meditation Room on August 21, 2026. Where: Unity of Boulder Spiritual Center - Meditation Room, Boulder. Price: Sliding scale $15-$25. Details: https://soundbathcalendar.com/event/sound-circle-energy-healing-sound-bath-with-bruce-white-2026-08-21-unity-of-boulder-spiritual-center-meditation-room/

item.title: Sacred Resonance Sound Healing
item.description: A sound healing session led by Caressa Ayres at Unity of Boulder Spiritual Center, third Friday of the month; Tibetan bowls, crystal vessels and tuning forks at 432hz. Doors 6:45pm, $40 advance or $45 at the door. Where: Unity of Boulder Spiritual Center, Boulder. Price: $40 advance / $45 door. Details: https://soundbathcalendar.com/event/sacred-resonance-sound-healing-2026-08-21-unity-of-boulder-spiritual-center/

item.title: Yoga Nidra Journey in the Salt Cave
item.description: A 90-minute yoga nidra in the Himalayan salt cave at Diamond Vitality Center, Louisville, Saturday afternoon, with crystal bowls, harmonium and guitar; participants recline in chairs. Led by Mira Devi. Where: Diamond Vitality Center, Boulder. Price: See link. Details: https://soundbathcalendar.com/event/yoga-nidra-journey-in-the-salt-cave-2026-08-22-diamond-vitality-center/

item.title: Full Moon Healing Cloud of Sound Meditation Concert with Sarina Shrestha
item.description: A one-hour lie-down full-moon sound meditation at the Atma Buti Sound & Vibrational School in Boulder, Thursday evening, on Himalayan bowls, gongs and bells; led by Sarina Shrestha. Mats provided. Where: Atma Buti Sound & Vibrational School, Boulder. Price: See link. Details: https://soundbathcalendar.com/event/full-moon-healing-cloud-of-sound-meditation-concert-with-sarina-shrestha-2026-08-27-atma-buti-sound-vibrational-school/

item.title: Lunar Eclipse Meditation & Six Gong Sound Bath
item.description: A two-hour lunar-eclipse session at The StarHouse in North Boulder, Friday evening: Kundalini movement and meditation closing with a six-gong sound bath. Ages 13+. Where: The StarHouse, Boulder. Price: See link. Details: https://soundbathcalendar.com/event/lunar-eclipse-meditation-six-gong-sound-bath-2026-08-28-the-starhouse/
